name: Jolla Phone 2 (JP2601)
_comment: Shipped device profile: measured corrections for this camera module (docs/DEVICE-PROFILES.md). A key in your own override-hal.json replaces the same key here.

cameras._focus_calibration_note: Measured on one JP2 (scripts/focus-calib.sh, October 2026): the HAL's lens value for each real distance, interpolated in diopters. A user's own table (override-hal.json or the calibration assistant) replaces these distances and adds others. Camera 2 (the 18 mm) focuses too and has no table yet.
